snippet.title: Cerulean Singe Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Here! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530550/Cerulean_Singe/

About the Game:
Cerulean Singe is a souls-like focusing on snappy and deliberate fast-paced combat, unrelenting bosses, and an immersive world to explore.

Locals from the nearby village have gone mad with a new discovery. Their eyes filled blue flame, some being physically altered, gaining unseen strength. The enchanting blue flames burn hotter than anything ever previously known. Fight your way through to the source of what is causing all the chaos around you.

Or Will You Succumb to the Blue Flames Yourself?
